supportRetentionPolicy: We keep enquiries and attachments for as long as we need them to deal with your request. supportPrivacyDetails: We handle enquiries about using the app on the basis of Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR where this is necessary for the user relationship or for steps before entering into a contract. For other enquiries the basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR: our legitimate interest in answering questions and resolving problems. Where statutory retention obligations apply, the basis is Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR.
websitePrivacyBasis: We provide and secure this website on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is an available, working information service about the app that is protected against misuse.
applicablePrivacyRightsAndSupervisoryAut: Subject to the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability (Art. 15-20 GDPR). You can withdraw any consent you have given with effect for the future. You can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, in particular where you usually live or work or where the alleged infringement took place (Art. 77 GDPR).
